title: Closure World Registration
$comment: One frozen world registration for DESIGN-compile-before-query. Committed BEFORE the builder exists (ROADMAP-v0.15 item 1 preregistration), so the horizon, ceilings, source snapshot, and action schema cannot be tuned to make a construction gate pass. The action schema is DATA — a finite product of action names and typed parameter values — never a callback: the generic checker enumerates the product itself and does not trust a builder or adapter to reveal which actions exist. An adapter maps each enumerated (name, params) pair to its native action; that mapping is code, pinned by the adapter digest recorded in the closure, not declared here.

adapter_id.$comment: Selects the adapter implementation from the registry in scripts/closure_worlds.py. The generic builder and checker are forbidden from branching on a world name; this declared id is the one sanctioned selection mechanism (design §5).

horizon.$comment: States at exactly this depth are boundary states: they are not called exhausted and make no claim about the next step. Frozen at preregistration; a closure that cannot finish under it reports a miss, it does not get a larger number.

ceilings.$comment: Design §8 constants as consts, not free integers: a registration that tried to relax a ceiling would fail schema validation rather than quietly moving the gate.

source.$comment: The frozen source snapshot the adapter builds the initial state and native actions from. Its shape is adapter-specific; its bytes are pinned by data/closure_worlds/manifest.json (canonical-LF SHA-256). Deliberately not closed here: closing it would force this schema to change for every new world, and the manifest digest is the integrity mechanism, not this schema.

values.$comment: String values only. The product of these lists IS the world's complete syntactic action set at every interior state; an action outside it does not exist, and an action inside it that the world rejects is recorded as a refusal edge, never omitted.
